sections.title: Connecting Routine Actions
sections.content:
To tell a coherent story about your day, link routine actions using sequence markers:
- **Primero**: first
- **Luego / Después**: then / afterwards
- **Antes de + infinitivo**: before doing something
- **Después de + infinitivo**: after doing something
- **Por último / Al final**: finally / at last

items.spanish: Primero me despierto, luego me levanto.
items.english: First I wake up, then I get up.

items.spanish: Tomo un vaso de agua antes de ducharme.
items.english: I drink a glass of water before showering.

items.spanish: Después de vestirme, tomo café con Carlos.
items.english: After getting dressed, I drink coffee with Carlos.

items.spanish: Por último, me lavo los dientes y me acuesto.
items.english: Finally, I brush my teeth and go to bed.

sections.content: Notice that after prepositions like *antes de* or *después de*, the verb stays in the infinitive, and the reflexive pronoun is attached directly to the end: *antes de duchar**me***.
